title: A critic voice under pressure
statement: Whether a critic voice in a panel of AI agents softens its disagreement when a student pushes back is untested.
detail: Research for the Grade 9 lesson ideas listed sycophancy among the risks of AI voices in a lesson: a 2026 position preprint frames it as an educational safety risk for language models that teach, and a 2025 simulated-tutoring study measured models conforming to a student's stated wrong view (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0249-g9-idea-research-full-files.qmd`). Nothing it found tests whether a critic voice in a multi-agent panel softens its disagreement under social pressure from the student, and it flags that as an open risk (the same file).

evidence.quote: Untested anywhere found: whether a "critic" voice in a multi-agent panel softens its disagreement under social pressure from the student — flag as an open risk.
a 2025 simulated-tutoring study measured models conforming to a student's stated (wrong) view
